facts.fact: DatacenterDynamics lists Somalia's current landings as DARE1 at Mogadishu and Bosaso and Gulf2Africa (G2A) at Bosaso and Berbera, so two cables land at different stations.
DatacenterDynamics reports Hormuud Telecom's newly completed Somali cable landing station (location undisclosed) is open-access and will accommodate various submarine cables.

systems.tiers: due to land at Mogadishu and Berbera, not yet in service

note: Landing list is garbled in the source; Berbera is in Somaliland.
